name: Shaanxi Huada Science Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Shaanxi Huada Science Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of electrical connectors and interconnection products in People's Republic of China. The company offers RF coaxial connectors, including threaded locking and push-to-lock connectors; and RF coaxial assembly products, which consist of flexible, and semi-flexible, specialty cable assemblies.
